from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyRevenue(BaseModel):
    """Captures the revenue data found in a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report")
    revenue_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label used in the document (e.g., 'Net sales', 'Revenues')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical revenue value as reported in the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period for which revenue is reported")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_records: list[CompanyRevenue]
